_comment: ai-blocker-watch settings. repos: every u2giants/* and popcre/* repo with an issue or PR opened in the last 90 days (audited 2026-09-17; archived and zero-activity repos excluded) — re-audit when repos change. propagate_on_host: the ONE machine (hostname) that scans and posts blocker comments; every other machine still wakes its own sessions, so N machines never post N copies of a comment. Absent key = propagate here (single-machine installs). harness: how a waiting session is resumed; {session}, {cwd}, {prompt}, {home} and {zcode_builtin} (newest ZCode provider runtime file) are substituted per argument. ZCode headless needs a one-time CLI sign-in (zcode.cjs login) before its wakes succeed — on Windows copy the full login URL from the terminal, because auto-open truncates it at '&'. Override the whole file with AI_BLOCKER_WATCH_CONFIG.
